task: N02 -- targeted reversal search retaining the local-indistinguishability condition
status: existence diagnostic only; success would not show the reversal is common, that a full seed-selection algorithm loses much, or that learning would help

propagation.graph_reading: undirected simple graph; each edge gives two propagation directions
propagation.bidirectional_randomness: the two directions are sampled independently
propagation.common_random_numbers: one live/dead state per directed arc per world, shared by all four seed sets of a comparison
propagation.r_h_convention: R_h includes the source node and follows the actual message-passing direction

original_condition_retained.condition: (R2(a) u R2(b)) n (R2(c) u R2(d)) = empty
original_condition_retained.note: the N01-S relaxation was NOT used
original_condition_retained.local_indistinguishability: under this condition no output node's two-layer receptive field can contain candidates from both the {a,b} side and the {c,d} side, so a two-layer per-node-summing proxy necessarily gives the same difference for delta_c and delta_d
original_condition_retained.official_code_note: SpreadPredictor uses two SAGEConv layers and the search sums per-node outputs, which supports the applicability of this argument; the official forward pass was still never executed here

selection.r2_convention: includes the source node; forward message-passing direction
selection.q3_note: structural screen only; not a spread estimate and not evidence about learning
selection.tie_break: Q_3 descending, then the node-index tuple

backgrounds.uniform_U: 8 nodes drawn uniformly from the LCC excluding the candidates
backgrounds.degree_U: the 8 highest-degree nodes excluding candidates, ties by ascending index

statistics.r_dev_definition: max{ min(-d_c, d_d), min(d_c, -d_d) }; positive = development point estimates already reverse, negative = they do not
statistics.selection_rule: r_dev descending, 4 per background, each quadruple at most once, ties by comparison id; applied even when no r_dev is positive
statistics.peeking_disclosure: the confirmation set was chosen using real diffusion output, so this is a privileged diagnostic, not a deployable rule; the post-selection reversal frequency does not estimate a natural rate
statistics.computed_not_transcribed: the quantile is computed from the closed-form t CDF at run time
statistics.interval_kind: approximate simultaneous Monte Carlo interval; NOT a strict finite-sample certificate
